epen_2025_edu4._note: EPEN 2025, employed workers by education (4 groups), weighted totals; hours of the main job. Aggregates computed in the thesis (data/enaho/output/epen_kappa_moments_edu4_2025.csv); no microdata here. M3 data = formal hours share of the two upper groups minus that of the two lower groups.

enaho_own_quintiles._note: Own computation with ENAHO annual microdata (code/data/build_enaho_quintiles.py; microdata not in the repo). Employed ocu500==1, weight fac500a, informal ocupinf==1; quintiles of household expenditure per capita (gashog2d/mieperho) on the population distribution. Reproduces INEI (2022) Cuadro 7.5 for 2021 within 0.2 pp and the 2022 national rate (75.7). ocupinf is not published after 2023.

inei_2022_cuadro_7_5._note: Tasa de empleo informal (%) de la poblacion ocupada por quintil, Peru. INEI (2022), Peru: Evolucion de los Indicadores de Empleo e Ingresos por Departamento, 2007-2021, Cuadro 7.5 (p. 120 impresa, p. 131 del PDF Lib1870), con ENAHO. Ultima edicion con el corte por quintil encontrada (15 oct 2026). 2020-2021: pandemia.

inei_2018_cuadro_7_5._note: Tasa de empleo informal (%) de la poblacion ocupada por quintil, Peru 2017. INEI (2018), Peru: Evolucion de los indicadores de empleo e ingresos por departamento, 2007-2017, Cuadro 7.5, con ENAHO. Quintiles of household expenditure per capita (resolved by replicating the 2021 edition with ENAHO; not wealth).
